knowledge_point.title: Calculating Scalar Triple Products Using Its Properties

question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we factor out the constants and get

$$
\begin{aligned}2a\cdot (b\times c) & =2 \\ 2\cdot [a\cdot (b\times c)] & =2 \\ a\cdot (b\times c) & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we swap $a$ and $b$ to get

$$
\begin{aligned}b\cdot (a\times c) & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$

recipes: multiply rather than divide supplied factor
